admin_users_description: Invite, assign roles, and manage user accounts.
admin_users_search_placeholder: Search users by name or email
admin_users_invite_drawer_subtitle: Send email invites or generate a shareable link. Invitees pick their password and land on Profile.
admin_users_invite_emails_hint: One per line, or separated by commas. Each invitee gets a 7-day link by email.
admin_users_invite_max_uses_hint: Once exhausted the link stops working. Pick 1 for a single-recipient link, or 0 for unlimited.
admin_users_invite_role_email_hint: Each invitee will be created with this role
admin_users_invite_role_link_hint: Anyone with this link signs up as
admin_users_detail_role_subtitle: Determines which areas of Media Manager this user can access.
admin_users_detail_role_self_lock: You can't demote yourself from admin while you are the only admin. Promote another user first.
admin_users_detail_sessions_subtitle_one: 1 active session across this user's devices.
admin_users_detail_sessions_subtitle_man: {count} active sessions across this user's devices.
admin_users_detail_danger_subtitle: Permanently deletes the account, sessions, watchlist, and feedback. This can't be undone.
admin_users_detail_confirm_delete_body: Permanently removes the account, all sessions, watchlist, requests, and feedback. {email} won't be able to sign back in.
admin_users_detail_confirm_sessions_body: Every active session for this user is revoked. They'll need to sign in again from scratch.
admin_roles_description: Define what users with each role can do.
admin_roles_group_system_hint: Built-in. Can't be deleted or renamed.
admin_roles_group_custom_hint: Defined for this server. Edit, duplicate, or delete.
admin_roles_seed_admin_description: Full server access. Bypasses every permission check.
admin_roles_seed_member_description: Standard user — personal connections, watchlist, requests, and feedback.
admin_roles_seed_viewer_description: Read-only — can browse but not request, rate, or link external services.
admin_roles_seed_curator_description: Member who can also approve and deny requests from the queue.
admin_roles_detail_system_notice: System roles are seeded by the server and can't be edited or removed. Duplicate this role to use it as a starting point for a custom role.
admin_roles_detail_permissions_subtitle_: Admin bypasses every permission check in code. The list below is read-only.
Toggle individual permissions, or whole scopes via the scope header.
admin_roles_detail_members_section_empty: No users currently have this role.
admin_roles_detail_confirm_delete_body_e: No users have this role, so this is safe.
admin_roles_detail_confirm_delete_body_s: 1 user will be moved to "Member" before this role is deleted.
{count} users will be moved to "Member" before this role is deleted.
admin_roles_scope_media_description: What users can do with content — browse, request, react.
admin_roles_perm_media_discover_descript: Home feed, search, and external browsing.
admin_roles_perm_media_details_descripti: Open detail pages — overview, cast, trailers.
admin_roles_perm_media_activity_descript: View own watch and request history.
admin_roles_perm_media_feedback_descript: Rate, react, and leave notes on titles.
admin_roles_perm_account_connections_des: Link personal media-server and metadata accounts.
admin_roles_perm_account_profile_descrip: Edit own profile, password, and notifications.
admin_roles_perm_admin_users_description: Invite, assign roles, suspend, and remove accounts.
admin_roles_perm_admin_requests_descript: Approve, deny, or escalate any user's request.
admin_roles_perm_admin_jobs_description: Trigger, pause, and inspect background jobs.
